1.13 Suppose the spheres A and B in Exercise 1.12 have identical sizes. A third sphere of the same size but uncharged is brought in contact with the first, then brought in contact with the second, and finally removed from both. What is the new force of repulsion between A and B?
1.14 Figure 1.33 shows tracks of three charged particles in a uniform electrostatic field. Give the signs of the three charges. Which particle has the highest charge to mass ratio?

1.15 Consider a uniform electric field E = 3 × 10³ î N/C. (a)  What is  the flux of this field through a square of 10 cm on a side whose plane is parallel to the yz plane? (b) What is the  flux through the same square if the normal  to its plane makes a 60° angle with the x-axis?
1.16 What is the net flux of the uniform electric field of Exercise 1.15 through a cube of side 20 cm oriented so that its faces are parallel to the coordinate planes?
1.17 Careful measurement of the electric field at the surface of a black box indicates that the net outward flux through the surface of the box is 8.0 × 10³ Nm²/C. (a) What is the net charge inside the box? (b) If the net outward flux through the surface of the box were zero, could you conclude that there were no charges inside the box? Why or Why not?
1.18 A point charge +10 µC is a distance 5 cm directly above the centre of a square of side 10 cm, as shown in Fig. 1.34. What is the magnitude of the electric flux through the square? (Hint: Think of the square as one face of a cube with edge 10 cm.)

note: Page is the chapter's EXERCISES list: the tail of Exercise 1.12(a)+(b) carried over from the previous page, then 1.13-1.18, interleaved with two figures. Superscripts, the degree symbol and the hat were read from the image, not the text layer: the layer flattens 10⁻⁷ to '10–7', 10³ to '103' and Nm²/C to 'Nm2/C'. Both figure bboxes are drawn to extend below the artwork so that the figure's own printed caption line ('FIGURE 1.33', 'FIGURE 1.34') falls inside the box, and the Fig. 1.34 box is wide and tall enough to take all three of its dimension labels ('5 cm' above the plane, the rotated '10 cm' on the right edge, and '10 cm' on the bottom edge); both captions and all labels are left to the special transcriber. Bold exercise numbers are recorded in bold_terms; the bold vector symbol E in 1.15 is excluded as vector notation. Removed furniture: the 'Electric Charges and Fields' running header panel, the page number 47 and the reprint year 2022-23. The grey 'NCERT / not to be republished' watermark across the page is print-control decoration and is not transcribed.
